statement: Henselizations over explicit separably closed constants and every finite extension admit exact valuation residue integral-basis finite-quotient and factorization algorithms with infinite residue
notes: A full finite residue field table with basis lifts is certified by multiplication relations and ef=degree; no primitive residue element or coefficient section is assumed. Distinct fractional valuations give an actual integral basis. Every quotient is a finite-dimensional constant-field algebra, so Haran decides its equations. Greenberg supplies negative factor certificates.

statement: Complete ordinary canonical split WG over finite algebras and coherent local henselizations with finite extensions of infinite-residue henselian fields as coefficient or residue fields
notes: Generalized left-ideal and Lagrangian projective schemes give actual division factors and hermitian decisions over every finite fixed center. Full exact finite quotient access verifies the Greenberg hypotheses, replacing the former finite-residue argument. Actual lifts and literal Gram-pair coordinates give all finite operations.

statement: Explicit H_r with infinite separably closed residue and p-rank r+1 give further whole non-C1 field and nonfield coefficient families
notes: The p-basis t_1,...,t_r,u gives an anisotropic degree-p form in p^(r+1)>p variables. Transcendence degree r+1>=2 separates the family from global and henselian-global fields. Singular/nonreduced finite-algebra and affine local henselization examples are included.
